page.overview:
Who is Jacques Romaine?

Jacques Romaine was a Human male, and former chief engineer.

He was the husband of Lydia Romaine, and together they were the parents of Starfleet officer, Lieutenant Mira Romaine.

He had retired some time prior to 2269. ()
